_why: 3.4a step 2, the Net: a guard given the Net ability opens at Close. On its first turn it throws the net instead of closing (an attack roll with its own attack bonus against the fighter's AC); a hit leaves the fighter Restrained (escape DC 10). Its one use is spent, so later turns are ordinary. The fighter breaks free with an Athletics check. Seeded, with refresh.
